tool.name: CleaveRNA
tool.description: scoring candidate cleavage sites of DNAzyme
tool.command:
#if $mode_selector.mode == "training" mkdir -p input && #if $mode_selector.params_source.params_method == "upload" cp "$mode_selector.params_source.params_csv" input/params.csv && #else cp $params_file_config input/params.csv && ## remove the first line sed -i '1d' input/params.csv && #end if #for $f in $mode_selector.target_files_training #if $f.element_identifier.endswith('.fasta'): cp "$f" input/${f.element_identifier} && #else cp "$f" input/${f.element_identifier}.fasta && #end if #end for cleaverna --params input/params.csv --target_files_training input/*.fasta --prediction_mode default --model_name "$mode_selector.model_name" --output_dir output && mv output/${mode_selector.model_name}_user_merged_num.csv output/training_output.csv #else ## ---------- PREDICTION MODE ---------- #if $mode_selector.prediction_mode_selector.prediction_mode == "default" #set $model_name = str($mode_selector.prediction_mode_selector.model_name) mkdir -p input && mkdir -p output && mkdir -p training_data &&
## PARAMS (upload or generate) #if $mode_selector.prediction_mode_selector.params_source.params_method == "upload" cp "$mode_selector.prediction_mode_selector.params_source.params_csv" input/params.csv && #else echo "LA,RA,CS,Tem,CA" > input/params.csv && echo '$mode_selector.prediction_mode_selector.params_source.la,$mode_selector.prediction_mode_selector.params_source.ra,"#echo ",".join($mode_selector.prediction_mode_selector.params_source.cs)#",$mode_selector.prediction_mode_selector.params_source.tem,$mode_selector.prediction_mode_selector.params_source.ca' >> input/params.csv && #end if
## COPY TARGET FASTA FILES #for $f in $mode_selector.prediction_mode_selector.target_files_prediction #if $f.element_identifier.endswith('.fasta'): cp "$f" input/${f.element_identifier} && #else cp "$f" input/${f.element_identifier}.fasta && #end if #end for
## TRAINING FILE #if $mode_selector.prediction_mode_selector.training_file_source.training_file_method == "builtin" #set $training_file = $__tool_directory__ + "/data/" + str($mode_selector.prediction_mode_selector.training_file_source.training_builtin) #else #set $training_file = str($mode_selector.prediction_mode_selector.training_file_source.training_upload) #end if
## Extract training zip unzip -q "$training_file" -d training_data &&
## Find the single CSV and rename/link it exact to the zip base name ZIP_BASE_NAME=\$(basename "$training_file" .zip) && ORIGINAL_CSV=\$(find training_data -type f -name "*.csv" | head -n 1) && if [ "\$ORIGINAL_CSV" != "training_data/\${ZIP_BASE_NAME}.csv" ]; then mv "\$ORIGINAL_CSV" "training_data/\${ZIP_BASE_NAME}.csv"; fi &&
## TRAINING SCORES #if $mode_selector.prediction_mode_selector.training_scores_source.scores_method == "builtin" #set $training_scores = $__tool_directory__ + "/data/" + str($mode_selector.prediction_mode_selector.training_scores_source.scores_builtin) #else #set $training_scores = str($mode_selector.prediction_mode_selector.training_scores_source.scores_upload) #end if
cleaverna --params input/params.csv #for $f in $mode_selector.prediction_mode_selector.target_files_prediction #if $f.element_identifier.endswith('.fasta'): --target_files_prediction "input/${f.element_identifier}" #else --target_files_prediction "input/${f.element_identifier}.fasta" #end if #end for --prediction_mode default --model_name "$model_name" --training_file "training_data/\${ZIP_BASE_NAME}.csv" --training_scores "$training_scores" --output_dir output && mv output/${model_name}_ML_train_feature_set.csv output/ml_train_feature_set.csv && mv output/${model_name}_ML_train.csv output/ml_train.csv && mv output/${model_name}_ML_metrics.csv output/ml_metrics.csv && mv output/${model_name}_CleaveRNA_output.csv output/cleaverna_output.csv && mv output/${model_name}_balanced_classification.csv output/balanced_classification.csv && mv output/parameters.cfg output/prediction_parameters.cfg
#elif $mode_selector.prediction_mode_selector.prediction_mode == "target_check" ## params (multi-row repeat) #set $params_file = $mode_selector.prediction_mode_selector.params_csv ## training file #if $mode_selector.prediction_mode_selector.training_file_source.training_file_method == "builtin" #set $training_file = "$__tool_directory__/data/" + $mode_selector.prediction_mode_selector.training_file_source.training_builtin #else #set $training_file = $mode_selector.prediction_mode_selector.training_file_source.training_upload #end if ## training scores #if $mode_selector.prediction_mode_selector.training_scores_source.scores_method == "builtin" #set $training_scores = "$__tool_directory__/data/" + $mode_selector.prediction_mode_selector.training_scores_source.scores_builtin #else #set $training_scores = $mode_selector.prediction_mode_selector.training_scores_source.scores_upload #end if ## RUN cleaverna \ --prediction_mode target_check \ --params "$params_file" \ --model_name "$mode_selector.prediction_mode_selector.model_name" \ #for $f in $mode_selector.prediction_mode_selector.target_files_prediction --target_files_prediction "$f" \ #end for --training_file "$training_file"/*.csv \ --training_scores "$training_scores" \ --output_dir .
#elif $mode_selector.prediction_mode_selector.prediction_mode == "target_screen" ## params #set $params_file = $mode_selector.prediction_mode_selector.params_csv ## training file #if str($mode_selector.prediction_mode_selector.training_file_source.training_file_method) == "builtin" #set $training_file = $__tool_directory__ + "/data/" + str($mode_selector.prediction_mode_selector.training_file_source.training_builtin) #else #set $training_file = $mode_selector.prediction_mode_selector.training_file_source.training_upload #end if ## training scores #if str($mode_selector.prediction_mode_selector.training_scores_source.scores_method) == "builtin" #set $training_scores = $__tool_directory__ + "/data/" + str($mode_selector.prediction_mode_selector.training_scores_source.scores_builtin) #else #set $training_scores = $mode_selector.prediction_mode_selector.training_scores_source.scores_upload #end if cleaverna \ --prediction_mode target_screen \ --params "$params_file" \ --model_name "$mode_selector.prediction_mode_selector.model_name" \ #for $f in $mode_selector.prediction_mode_selector.target_files_prediction --target_files_prediction "$f" \ #end for --training_file "$training_file"/*.csv \ --training_scores "$training_scores" \ --output_dir .
## Specific_query #elif $mode_selector.prediction_mode_selector.prediction_mode == "specific_query" ## params #set $params_file = $mode_selector.prediction_mode_selector.params_csv ## training file #if str($mode_selector.prediction_mode_selector.training_file_source.training_file_method) == "builtin" #set $training_file = $__tool_directory__ + "/data/" + str($mode_selector.prediction_mode_selector.training_file_source.training_builtin) #else #set $training_file = $mode_selector.prediction_mode_selector.training_file_source.training_upload #end if ## training scores #if str($mode_selector.prediction_mode_selector.training_scores_source.scores_method) == "builtin" #set $training_scores = $__tool_directory__ + "/data/" + str($mode_selector.prediction_mode_selector.training_scores_source.scores_builtin) #else #set $training_scores = $mode_selector.prediction_mode_selector.training_scores_source.scores_upload #end if cleaverna \ --prediction_mode specific_query \ --params "$params_file" \ --model_name "$mode_selector.prediction_mode_selector.model_name" \ #for $f in $mode_selector.prediction_mode_selector.target_files_prediction --target_files_prediction "$f" \ #end for --training_file "$training_file"/*.csv \ --training_scores "$training_scores" \ --output_dir . #end if #end if
tool.help:
This tool performs DNAzyme cleavage site prediction on RNA sequences using machine learning models. It supports both training and prediction modes with customizable parameters for DNAzyme analysis.
**Training Mode:** - Input RNA sequences in FASTA format. - Generate training feature matrices based on specified DNAzyme parameters. - Output training features for model development.
**Prediction Mode:** - Input RNA sequences in FASTA format. - Choose from multiple analysis modes: Default, Target Check, Target Screen, and Specific Query. - Customize DNAzyme parameters or upload parameter files for feature generation. - Output cleavage site predictions along with machine learning metrics.
For detailed instructions and parameter descriptions, please refer to the tool documentation.
